scientific_integrity: The full new classification is proved by forced incidence matchings, exact rank certificates, group orbit transitivity, and three-chart geometric-smoothness Gröbner unit ideals. The independent finite coefficient census does not by itself imply geometric smoothness.
scientific_limitations: Exactly Baer-subplane rational point sets for geometrically smooth plane quartics over the four-element field; not a classification of arbitrary blocking curves, not full geometric automorphism groups; older unindexed priority risk remains.
title: Baer-subplane rigidity for smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbb F_4\)
